note: Accepted exceptions to the js-supply-chain gate (scripts/npm_audit_gate.mjs). Policy, entry format and the rules behind every field: docs/NPM_AUDIT_SEVERITY_POLICY_DECISION.md sections 4, 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3. An empty list is written as "allow": [] and never as a missing file. Adding an entry requires an owner decision; every field is required, the id is a GHSA id, and expiresOn may be at most 90 days after approvedOn (D-3). An entry whose advisory has left the audit fails the gate and must be deleted (D-5).

allow.rationale: Renewal approved on 2026-10-17 by avihay1989@gmail.com through 2026-11-14, a 28-day lease extending the initial deadline by 14 days. See the owner ruling in docs/NPM_AUDIT_SEVERITY_POLICY_DECISION.md section 6.3 and issue #513. Re-measured against merged #516 at 3da2b70: the actual audit still consumes GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm at high; the advisory is not withdrawn, covers braces <=3.0.3 and has no patched version. Registry latest is braces 3.0.3, micromatch 4.0.8 and stylelint 17.16.0. The committed graph still reaches braces 3.0.3 through micromatch 4.0.8 by four paths: stylelint 16.11.0 -> micromatch; stylelint -> fast-glob 3.3.3 -> micromatch; stylelint -> globby 11.1.0 -> fast-glob -> micromatch; and sass 1.103.1 -> @parcel/watcher 2.5.1 (optional) -> micromatch. The unresolved blocker is the three stylelint paths: latest stylelint still declares micromatch, fast-glob and globby, and latest micromatch still requires braces ^3.0.3. Watcher 2.6.0 can retire the Sass path separately by replacing micromatch with picomatch ^4.0.4, but that does not clear the advisory. All paths are dev tooling and package.json declares no runtime dependencies; per D-2 this is context, not a carve-out. The exposure is stack exhaustion from deeply nested brace patterns in glob input; the original exposure assessment in section 6.2 still applies. Retire this entry under D-5 when a validated updated lockfile and actual audit show the advisory no longer requires an exception, then confirm the real gate passes after deletion. A patched braces, removal of every path, withdrawal, or a severity reduction below the floor triggers re-measurement. Any further renewal requires a fresh owner decision.
